"""Python baseline for examples/expenses/expenses.ax."""
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel

from baselines.runtime import Runtime


class ExpenseClassification(BaseModel):
    classification: Literal["business", "personal", "unclear"]


def main(rt: Runtime) -> list[dict]:
    """Process all pending expense claims."""
    results = []

    # 1. List pending expense ids and fetch each
    pending_ids = rt.call("expenses.pending", "main#0")

    for expense_id in pending_ids:
        expense = rt.call("expenses.get", f"main#1:{expense_id}", id=expense_id)

        # 2. Look up employee in directory
        employee = rt.call("directory.lookup", f"main#2:{expense_id}", email=expense["employee_email"])

        # 3. Ask model to classify the expense
        classification = rt.ask(
            "llm",
            f"main#3:{expense_id}",
            ExpenseClassification,
            'Classify this expense as "business", "personal", or "unclear".',
            context=expense["note"],
            retries=1,
        )

        # 4. Decide per expense
        status = process_expense(rt, expense, employee, classification.classification, expense_id)

        results.append({"expense_id": expense_id, "status": status})

    # 5. Return results
    return results


def process_expense(rt: Runtime, expense: dict, employee: dict, classification: str, expense_id: str) -> str:
    """Determine expense status and take appropriate actions."""
    # Currency is not EUR or classification is unclear
    if expense["currency"] != "EUR" or classification == "unclear":
        rt.call(
            "mail.send",
            f"process_expense#0:{expense_id}",
            to=employee["manager_email"],
            subject=f"Expense {expense_id} needs review",
            body="",
        )
        return "needs review"

    # Classification is personal
    if classification == "personal":
        rt.call(
            "mail.send",
            f"process_expense#1:{expense_id}",
            to=employee["email"],
            subject=f"Expense {expense_id} rejected",
            body="",
        )
        return "rejected"

    # Amount exceeds reimbursement limit
    if expense["amount"] > employee["reimbursement_limit"]:
        rt.call(
            "mail.send",
            f"process_expense#2:{expense_id}",
            to=employee["manager_email"],
            subject=f"Expense {expense_id} needs review",
            body="",
        )
        return "needs review"

    # Otherwise, reimburse the expense
    rt.call(
        "payroll.reimburse",
        f"process_expense#3:{expense_id}",
        employee_id=employee["id"],
        amount=expense["amount"],
        expense_id=expense_id,
    )
    return "reimbursed"

"""Python baseline for examples/expenses (expense reimbursement workflow)."""
from __future__ import annotations

from baselines.runtime import Runtime


def main(rt: Runtime) -> list[dict]:
    """Process pending expense claims and return status for each."""
    # Step 1: List pending expense ids
    pending_ids = rt.call("expenses.pending", "main#0")

    results = []
    call_index = 1

    for expense_id in pending_ids:
        # Fetch the expense
        expense = rt.call("expenses.get", f"main#{call_index}", id=expense_id)
        call_index += 1

        # Look up the employee in directory
        employee = rt.call("directory.lookup", f"main#{call_index}", email=expense["employee_email"])
        call_index += 1

        # Ask model to classify the expense note
        classification = rt.ask(
            "llm",
            f"main#{call_index}",
            str,
            f"Classify this expense note as 'business', 'personal', or 'unclear'. Return only one word.",
            context=expense["note"],
            retries=1
        )
        call_index += 1

        # Decide per expense
        status = None

        # Check if currency is not EUR or classification is unclear
        if expense["currency"] != "EUR" or classification == "unclear":
            status = "needs review"
            rt.call("mail.send", f"main#{call_index}", to=employee["manager_email"],
                   subject=f"Expense {expense_id} needs review", body="")
            call_index += 1
        # Check if personal expense
        elif classification == "personal":
            status = "rejected"
            rt.call("mail.send", f"main#{call_index}", to=employee["email"],
                   subject=f"Expense {expense_id} rejected", body="")
            call_index += 1
        # Check if amount exceeds reimbursement limit
        elif expense["amount"] > employee["reimbursement_limit"]:
            status = "needs review"
            rt.call("mail.send", f"main#{call_index}", to=employee["manager_email"],
                   subject=f"Expense {expense_id} needs review", body="")
            call_index += 1
        # Otherwise: approve for reimbursement
        else:
            rt.call("payroll.reimburse", f"main#{call_index}",
                   employee_id=employee["id"], amount=expense["amount"], expense_id=expense_id)
            call_index += 1
            status = "reimbursed"

        results.append({"expense_id": expense_id, "status": status})

    return results

"""Python baseline for examples/expenses/expenses.ax"""
from __future__ import annotations

from baselines.runtime import Runtime


def main(rt: Runtime) -> list[dict]:
    # Get all pending expense IDs
    expense_ids = rt.call("expenses.pending", "main#0")

    results = []
    for expense_id in expense_ids:
        result = process_expense(rt, expense_id)
        results.append(result)

    return results


def process_expense(rt: Runtime, expense_id: str) -> dict:
    # Fetch the expense
    expense = rt.call("expenses.get", f"get#{expense_id}", id=expense_id)

    # Look up the employee
    employee = rt.call("directory.lookup", f"lookup#{expense_id}", email=expense["employee_email"])

    # Ask the model to classify the expense
    classification = rt.ask(
        "llm",
        f"classify#{expense_id}",
        str,
        "Classify this expense claim. Return one of: business, personal, unclear",
        context=expense["note"],
        retries=1
    )

    # Decide per expense
    status = None

    # Check currency is EUR or classification is unclear
    if expense["currency"] != "EUR" or classification == "unclear":
        status = "needs review"
        rt.call("mail.send", f"mail-review#{expense_id}",
                to=employee["manager_email"],
                subject=f"Expense {expense_id} needs review",
                body="")
    # Check if classification is personal
    elif classification == "personal":
        status = "rejected"
        rt.call("mail.send", f"mail-reject#{expense_id}",
                to=employee["email"],
                subject=f"Expense {expense_id} rejected",
                body="")
    # Check if amount exceeds reimbursement limit
    elif expense["amount"] > employee["reimbursement_limit"]:
        status = "needs review"
        rt.call("mail.send", f"mail-review-limit#{expense_id}",
                to=employee["manager_email"],
                subject=f"Expense {expense_id} needs review",
                body="")
    # Otherwise, reimburse
    else:
        rt.call("payroll.reimburse", f"reimburse#{expense_id}",
                employee_id=employee["id"],
                amount=expense["amount"],
                expense_id=expense_id)
        status = "reimbursed"

    return {"expense_id": expense_id, "status": status}
